channel.title: Farsçadan (English)

item.title: U.S. Ankara Ambassador Barrack: We're close to a deal reducing tension with Iran
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: U.S. Ambassador to Turkey Tom Barrack said the U.S. is close to an agreement reducing tensions with Iran, with possible progress within two weeks. (Source: IRNA)
